info.title: REALITY API
info.description: Real-World State Network. Versioned under /v1 (breaking changes go to /v2). Errors use { error, details?, requestId }. Every state carries truth (KNOWN/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT), freshness, confidence, nature and sources. UNKNOWN never means safe.
